summary: Names Chutes (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-TEE, 1,048,576-token context, confidential compute, confirmed from the live model list) as the one scheduled external model provider for client intake, and builds the capability as a per-client switch that defaults off. A provider can be built only from the schedule and an opt-in only from a signed-document reference; only an explicit reviewer request reaches the provider, logged as an E5 release before sending, carrying the brief but never contact details. No client content is sent: the store refuses any record with a non-synthetic reference until the owner lifts that in code, and the path is proved with one live synthetic record. E8, E7 and counsel brief sections 7 and 4.8 are unchanged; Launchpad stays on Engy. No collection, deployment, security acceptance or qualification is authorized.
